title: Ali Asghar Ali Asghar Ali
body:
Ali Asghar Ali Asghar Ali Asghar Ali Asghar Ali Asghar
1. Aaja tujhe seene se laga lo Ali Asghar
Beta tera jhoola mai jhoola loo Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Le jaate hai baba tujhe maidan e wega
Mein ruk jaa nayi poshak penha loo Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Gardan pa tere teer lage ga mere jani
Boosa tere hulqoom ka le loo Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ro ro ke Sakina yeh sada deti hai ran mein
Aajaa tujhe goodi mein betha loo Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Aa gosh e lahed mein tujhe neend ayegi kaise
Aa gosh e mohabbat mein sulaa loo Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Furqat teri aye laal gawara nahi mujhko
Aajaa tujhe ankhon mein basa loo Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ran mein yeh Kaleem aa k bayan karti thi bano
Turbat pa do aanshoo to baha loo Ali Asghar
Azz..khaiser Kaleem..
